question: The marked price of an article is ₹2,500. A shopkeeper gives three successive discounts of 25%, 20% and K%, and sells the article at ₹1,380. Find the value of K.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The **Marked Price (MP)** is ₹2,500.

After 1st discount (25%): 2,500 × (100 − 25) ÷ 100 = ₹1,875.

After 2nd discount (20%): 1,875 × (100 − 20) ÷ 100 = ₹1,500.

Final **Selling Price (SP)** is given as ₹1,380.

Discount amount for K% = 1,500 − 1,380 = ₹120.

Value of K = (120 ÷ 1,500) × 100 = 8%.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** MP = ₹2,500, SP = ₹1,380, d₁ = 25%, d₂ = 20%, d₃ = K%.

**Formula:** SP = MP × (100 − d₁)/100 × (100 − d₂)/100 × (100 − d₃)/100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08c3f1fb7be7de89e540478fee92ef2ea866798f90e787d9eb27f95b68865693.png] 

⇒ 1,380 = 2,500 × (75/100) × (80/100) × (100 − K)/100

⇒ 1,380 = 2,500 × (3/4) × (4/5) × (100 − K)/100

⇒ 1,380 = 1,500 × (100 − K)/100

⇒ 1,380 = 15 × (100 − K)

⇒ 92 = 100 − K

⇒ K = 100 − 92 = 8.

**∴ The correct answer is 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts

When multiple discounts are applied one after another on the reduced price, they are called **successive discounts**. Total discount is not the simple sum of individual percentages.

Marked Price & Selling Price

**Marked Price (MP)** is the price printed on the article. **Selling Price (SP)** is the price after deducting the discount from the MP: SP = MP − Discount.
